acip: MA GRUB NA, DE CHOS CAN, DER THAL, KHYOD KYANG YIN, MI 'GAL BA DANG 'GAL BA YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA YOD PA'I PHYIR, 'GAL BA DE DE YIN PA'I PHYIR,

english: [It's not correct to say that the exclusion of all that is not something which is contradictory is something which is such that being it is not contradictory to being something which is such that being it is contradictory to being something which is not contradictory.] Suppose you say it's not correct. And this is because being something which is contradictory is just such a thing.
